scope: Research-only semantics and source-coverage contract; no model adapter/integration

components.target: All goals credited to the scoring team, including opponent own-goals
components.observed_sources: Official fixture score/event ledger
components.forecast_sources: Archived team intensity/credited player means; exact full team law not archived

components.target: Credited player goals, with mutually exclusive penalty/nonpenalty partition

components.limits: Includes eligible own-goal/rebound/penalty-winner awards; no self-assist; Opta assists/xA not interchangeable

2026-27.operational_status: Definitions verified; not activated in production

2025-26.limits: Official selected changes verified; archived helper omits being-tackled field, so its default-zero reconstruction is partial. Missing non-shot-save category is not automatically outside-shot.

2024-25.limits: Historical adapter retained as inherited evidence, not complete fresh rule certification; DCpoint zero is structural by absent rule, DCaction count missing.

temporal_contract: Forecast cutoff<=publication<deadline; labels only after final&&data_checked. Per-fixture events before GWaggregation; original issue hashes never overwritten. Unknown source publication times remain unknown.
missingness_contract: Missing/null never becomes observed0. Bounded is not point-identified. not_applicable requires a versioned rule reason; zero is a known numeric observation only with evidence.
negative_event_contract: Use normalized official card awards. Red deductions include yellow deductions; ambiguous raw double-card coding is unknown. Zero reported minutes does not prove no card/participation. No new card model here.
bonus_alias_contract: Canonical bonus_points is the observed award or its forecast expectation according to mode. Legacy expected_bonus is mapped to it exactly once; never sum both.
